Definition: (concretely) a boy (as active), from the age of infancy to adolescence; by implication, a servant; also (by interch. of sex), a girl (of similar latitude in age)
BiblicalUsage: 1) a boy, lad, servant, youth, retainer; 1a) boy, lad, youth; 1b) servant, retainer
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
